8 = 0x08 = 0b1000

.625 * 2 = 1.25 -> 1
.25 * 2 = 0.5 -> 0
.5 * 2 = 1 -> 1

1000.101 -> 1.000101 * 2^3

3 + 127 = 130
130 = 0b10000010

= 0 10000010 00010100000000000000000

0b01000001000010100000000000000000
